basic_profile.bio: A tech-savvy gamer based in Boulder, Colorado, who enjoys exploring both virtual and real-world adventures. As a software developer by day and a gaming enthusiast by night, I often find myself diving into tech forums and gaming subreddits. Besides gaming, I love hiking in the Rockies and am a huge fan of artisanal nougats. I usually browse Reddit in the late evenings after work. Currently single, enjoying the freedom to travel and explore new places.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a bachelor's degree in Computer Science from a liberal arts college, I've honed my coding skills through various tech projects and personal gaming mods. My interest in gaming has led me to become quite knowledgeable about game mechanics, often providing tips and troubleshooting advice to fellow gamers.
